Composition: Seen from the riverbank or gorge side at a low three-quarter angle, so the bridge itself is the subject: its arches, piers and full span crossing the frame, with the water (and its reflection) or the gorge filling the lower part of the image and the far bank behind. The deck is a narrow roadway running along the top of the bridge, not a wide plaza; anything on the deck (stalls, people, carts) is seen small, from the side, along the parapet.
Details to include: massive stone piers or iron girders, arches with weathered keystones, cutwaters at the base of the piers, parapets, lamp posts along the deck, small figures and carts crossing, boats on the water or mist in the gorge below. Little moments of life among the crowd: a cat stalking pigeons; a guard sharing an apple with a horse.
Environment: the heart of the kingdom — green river country, broad rivers and tree-lined avenues, iron lanterns, well-kept roads, soft temperate light.
